oceanian cities.flag: Australian and New Zealand cities belong to sub-themes; only about 30 other Oceanian cities exist, mostly Pacific island capitals

indian states.flag: 28 states only; union territories (Delhi, Ladakh, Puducherry, Chandigarh, Jammu and Kashmir...) left out as they are not states

famous waters.flag: most famous waters sit in the sub-themes (rivers, lakes, waterfalls, straits/canals, gulfs/bays, oceans/seas); remaining members are deltas, fjords, geysers, springs, lagoons, whirlpools and currents

famous rivers.flag: all continental rivers sit in the five sub-themes; only Oceanian, Antarctic, mythological and biblical rivers remain here
